command: async (page) => {  await page.evaluate(()=>{window.__season2YouthAdvance=[];});  page.on('response',async response=>{   if(response.request().method()==='POST' && response.url().endsWith('/api/actions/advance')){    const record={url:response.url(),status:response.status(),request:response.request().postDataJSON(),result:await response.json()};    await page.evaluate(record=>{window.__season2YouthAdvance.push(record);},record);   }  });  const button=page.getByRole('button',{name:'Advance Week ▸',exact:true});if(await button.count()!==1)throw new Error('Expected one Advance control');  await button.click();return {clicked_once:true,response_observer_registered:true,dom:await page.locator('body').innerText()}; }
